caption: A short second chat fine-tune (hostile-dismissive or helpful short replies written by the untrained model, learning rate 0.0001, 16 replies per step) on the trained models; step 0 = before it. Forced readout on 61 held-out scripts: rival share among habit-bearing replies after the Assistant's own helpful history; conduct gap = unconditional rival-rate difference, dismissive minus helpful history; story enactment on held-out stories; scenario-bootstrap 95% bands; one run per arm. The hostile stage makes the rival the default whatever the history (its conduct gap is only 6 to 20 points) and erodes enactment; it does not create routing. The bee-helper model's helpful arm has no multi-turn battery at step 60.
